I've set up the **Exchange** for you — Size 9 Running Shoes, arriving in 2 days at no extra charge. It's ready but **not completed**; nothing has been issued yet.

A couple of notes on your preferences:
- Since Exchange gets you an item (not cash), it doesn't involve money at all — you'll just receive the correct shoes at no charge.
- You'll still need to return the Size 8 pair using the included prepaid label, whenever you're able to get to a shipping option in the next week.
- If you'd rather have cash refunded instead of a physical item, that's the separate **Refund** option ($96 back to your original payment method in 3-5 days) — but that wouldn't get you shoes for your event in 3 days.

When you're ready, click **"✓ Approve & complete"** on the page to finalize the exchange. Let me know if you'd like me to switch it to something else first.
